composition: The canonical public Fig. 3 dataset uses the mean of three corrected FNO maps at validation resolution 128 for each training resolution and the locked U-Net/ResNet ensemble maps. The obsolete FNO channel in the unchanged architecture source is not used. The two upstream source artifacts are archived privately; this canonical NPZ is the authoritative public processed Fig. 3 dataset.

sources.selection: maps keyed by (train, 128, seed), mean over seeds 0001-0003
